description: This file defines an exception class 'UnreadableStreamException' used within the Laminas Diactoros library, specifically related to stream reading errors.

classes.name: UnreadableStreamException
classes.description: An exception class used to signal errors related to unreadable streams.

methods.name: dueToConfiguration
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the stream is not readable due to configuration issues.

methods.name: dueToMissingResource
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating no resource is available to read from.

methods.name: dueToPhpError
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating an error occurred while reading the stream.

methods.name: forCallbackStream
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating callback streams cannot be read.
